questions.question_english: P is daughter of Q, while Q and R are sisters of each other. S is mother of R. If M is son of S, then which of the following statements is correct?
questions.question_hindi: P Q की बेटी है, जबकि Q और R एक-दूसरे की बहनें हैं। S R की माँ है। यदि M S का बेटा है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
options_english: M is maternal uncle of P
options_hindi: M Q का चचेरा भाई है
questions.explanation_english: From the relationships given, we can deduce that since P is the daughter of Q, and Q is a sister to R, S must be the mother of both Q and R. M, being the son of S, is therefore a sibling to Q. Hence, Q is the sister of M, making the correct answer 'Q is brother of M' incorrect as it should be 'Q is sister of M'.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिए गए रिश्तों से, हम यह निष्कर्ष निकाल सकते हैं कि चूंकि P Q की बेटी है, और Q R की बहन है, इसलिए S को Q और R की माँ होना चाहिए। M, जो S का बेटा है, इसलिए Q का भाई नहीं बल्कि बहन है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'Q M का भाई है' गलत है क्योंकि इसे 'Q M की बहन है' होना चाहिए।
questions.explanation: From the relationships given, we can deduce that since P is the daughter of Q, and Q is a sister to R, S must be the mother of both Q and R. M, being the son of S, is therefore a sibling to Q. Hence, Q is the sister of M, making the correct answer 'Q is brother of M' incorrect as it should be 'Q is sister of M'.

questions.question_english:

true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follow(s) from the
given statements.
Statements:
Some numbers are digits. 
All digits are alphabets.
questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में, दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनके बाद चार निष्कर्ष विकल्पों में दिए गए हैं। आपको दिए गए कथनों को सत्य मानना है भले ही वे सामान्यतः ज्ञात तथ्यों के साथ भिन्न प्रतीत हों और फिर यह तय करना है कि दिए गए निष्कर्षों में से कौन सा दिए गए कथनों से तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है। 
कथन: 
कुछ संख्याएँ अंकों हैं। 
सभी अंक वर्णमाला हैं।
questions.explanation_english: Given the statements, we know that some numbers are digits and all digits are alphabets. Therefore, it logically follows that some alphabets cannot be numbers, as not all alphabets are digits. Hence, the correct conclusion is 'Some alphabets are not numbers'. The other options do not logically follow from the statements.
questions.explanation_hindi: दिए गए कथनों के अनुसार, हम जानते हैं कि कुछ संख्याएँ अंक हैं और सभी अंक वर्णमाला हैं। इसलिए, यह तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है कि कुछ वर्णमाला संख्याएँ नहीं हो सकतीं, क्योंकि सभी वर्णमाला अंक नहीं हैं। इसलिए, सही निष्कर्ष 'कुछ वर्णमाला संख्याएँ नहीं हैं' है। अन्य विकल्प कथनों से तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण नहीं करते।
questions.explanation: Given the statements, we know that some numbers are digits and all digits are alphabets. Therefore, it logically follows that some alphabets cannot be numbers, as not all alphabets are digits. Hence, the correct conclusion is 'Some alphabets are not numbers'. The other options do not logically follow from the statements.

questions.question_english:
In the question below, there are two statements followed by two conclusions. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem
to be at variance with commonly known facts and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follow(s) from the given statements. 
Statements : 
All horses are buffaloes.
All buffaloes are grass.
Conclusions : 
I. All horses are grass.
II. All grass are horses.
questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में, दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनके बाद दो निष्कर्ष हैं। आपको दिए गए कथनों को सत्य मानना है भले ही वे सामान्यतः ज्ञात तथ्यों के साथ भिन्न प्रतीत हों और फिर यह तय करना है कि दिए गए निष्कर्षों में से कौन सा दिए गए कथनों से तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है। 
कथन: 
सभी घोड़े भैंस हैं।
सभी भैंसें घास हैं।
निष्कर्ष: 
I. सभी घोड़े घास हैं।
II. सभी घास घोड़े हैं।
options_english: If either conclusion I or II follows
If neither conclusion I nor II follows
options_hindi: यदि केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
यदि केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
यदि या तो निष्कर्ष I या II अनुसरण करता है
यदि न तो निष्कर्ष I और न II अनुसरण करता है
questions.explanation_english: From the statements, we can conclude that since all horses are buffaloes and all buffaloes are grass, it logically follows that all horses must also be grass. However, the reverse is not true; not all grass can be horses. Therefore, the correct answer is 'If only conclusion I follows'.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथनों से, हम यह निष्कर्ष निकाल सकते हैं कि चूंकि सभी घोड़े भैंस हैं और सभी भैंसें घास हैं, इसलिए यह तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है कि सभी घोड़े भी घास हैं। हालाँकि, इसका उल्टा सही नहीं है; सभी घास घोड़े नहीं हो सकते। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'यदि केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है' है।
questions.explanation: From the statements, we can conclude that since all horses are buffaloes and all buffaloes are grass, it logically follows that all horses must also be grass. However, the reverse is not true; not all grass can be horses. Therefore, the correct answer is 'If only conclusion I follows'.

A river flows north to south and on the way turns left and goes in a quarter-circle round a hillock and then turns right at a right angle. In which
direction in the river finally flowing?
questions.question_hindi: एक नदी उत्तर से दक्षिण की ओर बहती है और रास्ते में बाईं ओर मुड़ती है और एक पहाड़ी के चारों ओर एक चौथाई वृत्त में जाती है और फिर दाईं ओर एक समकोण पर मुड़ती है। नदी अंततः किस दिशा में बह रही है?
questions.explanation_english:
To determine the final direction of the river, we can visualize the movements: 
1. The river flows from North to South. 
2. It turns left, which means it is now facing East. 
3. It then goes in a quarter-circle around a hillock, which means it continues to face South after completing the quarter-circle. 
4. Finally, it turns right at a right angle, which means it will now face West. Therefore, the river is finally flowing in the West direction. The correct answer is option A.

questions.question_english:
बादाम की कीमत पहले 30 Ůितशत बढ़ाई गई और उसके बाद 10 Ůितशत और 20 Ůितशत घटाई गई। यिद बादाम की नई कीमत 468 Ŝपए/िकŤा है, तो
इसकी शुŜआती कीमत Ɛा है?

questions.explanation_english: Let the initial price be x. After a 30% increase, the price becomes x + 0.3x = 1.3x. Then, after a 10% decrease, it becomes 1.3x - 0.1(1.3x) = 1.3x - 0.13x = 1.17x. questions.question_english:
Lokesh’s expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 7:5. If his income increased by 20 percent and expenditure increased by 10 percent, then by
how much percent do his savings increase?
questions.question_hindi:
Lokesh’s expenditure and savings are in the ratio of 7:5. If his income increased by 20 percent and expenditure increased by 10 percent, then by
how much percent do his savings increase?
questions.explanation_english: Let Lokesh's expenditure be 7x and savings be 5x. His income is 7x + 5x = 12x. After a 20% increase, his new income is 12x * 1.2 = 14.4x. After a 10% increase in expenditure, his new expenditure is 7x * 1.1 = 7.7x. His new savings = 14.4x - 7.7x = 6.7x. The increase in savings = 6.7x - 5x = 1.7x. The percentage increase = (1.7x / 5x) * 100 = 34%.
questions.explanation_hindi: मान लीजिए कि लोकेश का व्यय 7x और बचत 5x है। उसकी आय 7x + 5x = 12x है। 20% की वृद्धि के बाद, उसकी नई आय 12x * 1.2 = 14.4x है। 10% की वृद्धि के बाद, उसका नया व्यय 7x * 1.1 = 7.7x है। उसकी नई बचत = 14.4x - 7.7x = 6.7x। बचत में वृद्धि = 6.7x - 5x = 1.7x। प्रतिशत वृद्धि = (1.7x / 5x) * 100 = 34% है।
questions.explanation: Let Lokesh's expenditure be 7x and savings be 5x. His income is 7x + 5x = 12x. After a 20% increase, his new income is 12x * 1.2 = 14.4x. After a 10% increase in expenditure, his new expenditure is 7x * 1.1 = 7.7x. His new savings = 14.4x - 7.7x = 6.7x. The increase in savings = 6.7x - 5x = 1.7x. The percentage increase = (1.7x / 5x) * 100 = 34%.

questions.question_english: उस वृत की िũǛा ǒात करŐ िजसका Ɨेũफल उन वृतों के Ɨेũफल के योग के बराबर है िजनकी िũǛाएं Ţमश: 8 सेमी. तथा 15 सेमी. है।
questions.question_hindi: उस वृत की िũǛा ǒात करŐ िजसका Ɨेũफल उन वृतों के Ɨेũफल के योग के बराबर है िजनकी िũǛाएं Ţमश: 8 सेमी. तथा 15 सेमी. है।
questions.explanation_english: To find the radius of the circle whose area equals the sum of the areas of two circles with radii 8 cm and 15 cm, we first calculate the areas of the two circles. The area of a circle is given by the formula A = πr². For the first circle with radius 8 cm, the area is A1 = π(8)² = 64π cm². For the second circle with radius 15 cm, the area is A2 = π(15)² = 225π cm². The total area of both circles is A1 + A2 = 64π + 225π = 289π cm². Now, let the radius of the new circle be r. The area of this circle is A = πr². Setting this equal to the total area, we have πr² = 289π. Dividing both sides by π gives r² = 289, so r = √289 = 17 cm. Therefore, the correct answer is 17 cm.
questions.explanation_hindi: उस वृत की िũǛा ज्ञात करने के लिए, जिसका Ɨेũफल उन दो वृतों के Ɨेũफल के योग के बराबर है, पहले उन दोनों वृतों के Ɨेũफल की गणना करें। वृत का Ɨेũफल A = πr² के सूत्र से ज्ञात होता है। पहले वृत (जिसकी िũǛा 8 सेमी है) का Ɨेũफल A1 = π(8)² = 64π सेमी² है। दूसरे वृत (जिसकी िũǛा 15 सेमी है) का Ɨेũफल A2 = π(15)² = 225π सेमी² है। दोनों वृतों का कुल Ɨेũफल A1 + A2 = 64π + 225π = 289π सेमी² है। अब, मान लें कि नए वृत की िũǛा r है। इस वृत का Ɨेũफल A = πr² है। इसे कुल Ɨेũफल के बराबर रखते हुए, हमें πr² = 289π मिलता है। दोनों पक्षों को π से विभाजित करने पर r² = 289 मिलता है, अतः r = √289 = 17 सेमी। इसलिए सही उत्तर 17 सेमी है।

questions.question_english:
A solid sphere whose radius is 7 cm is melted and recast into a regular pyramid of square base. If height of the pyramid is 22 cm, then what is the
side of base of the pyramid?
questions.question_hindi:
A solid sphere whose radius is 7 cm is melted and recast into a regular pyramid of square base. If height of the pyramid is 22 cm, then what is the
side of base of the pyramid?
questions.explanation_english: First, we calculate the volume of the sphere using the formula V = (4/3)πr³. For a sphere with a radius of 7 cm, the volume is V = (4/3)π(7)³ = (4/3)π(343) = (1372/3)π cm³. Next, we find the volume of the pyramid using the formula V = (1/3)Bh, where B is the area of the base and h is the height. The area of the base (which is a square) is s², where s is the side length of the base. The height of the pyramid is given as 22 cm. Setting the volume of the sphere equal to the volume of the pyramid gives us (1372/3)π = (1/3)s²(22). Simplifying this, we find s² = (1372/22) = 62.36, so s = √62.36 ≈ 12 cm. Therefore, the correct answer is 12 cm.
questions.explanation_hindi: पहले, हम वृत का आयतन ज्ञात करते हैं, जिसका सूत्र V = (4/3)πr³ है। 7 सेमी की िũǛा वाले वृत का आयतन V = (4/3)π(7)³ = (4/3)π(343) = (1372/3)π सेमी³ है। इसके बाद, हम पिरामिड का आयतन ज्ञात करते हैं, जिसका सूत्र V = (1/3)Bh है, जहाँ B आधार का क्षेत्रफल है और h ऊँचाई है। आधार का क्षेत्रफल (जो कि एक वर्ग है) s² है, जहाँ s आधार की लंबाई है। पिरामिड की ऊँचाई 22 सेमी दी गई है। वृत के आयतन को पिरामिड के आयतन के बराबर रखते हुए, हमें (1372/3)π = (1/3)s²(22) मिलता है। इसे सरल करते हुए, हम पाते हैं s² = (1372/22) = 62.36, अतः s = √62.36 ≈ 12 सेमी। इसलिए सही उत्तर 12 सेमी है।

Next, we find the volume of the pyramid using the formula V = (1/3)Bh, where B is the area of the base and h is the height. questions.question_english: When the goods are imported from one country and the same are exported to another country, such trade is called :
questions.question_hindi: जब सामान एक देश से आयात किया जाता है और वही दूसरे देश को निर्यात किया जाता है, तो ऐसे व्यापार को क्या कहा जाता है:
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is C: 'एंट्रेपोट व्यापार'. This term refers to the practice of importing goods into one country and then exporting them to another without significant transformation. Option A 'निर्यात व्यापार' refers only to exporting goods. Option B 'अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार' is a broader term that includes all international trade activities. Option D 'बाह्य व्यापार' is also a general term for trade but does not specifically refer to the import-export cycle described.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर है C: 'एंट्रेपोट व्यापार'। यह शब्द उस प्रथा को संदर्भित करता है जिसमें सामान को एक देश में आयात किया जाता है और फिर बिना महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तन के दूसरे देश को निर्यात किया जाता है। विकल्प A 'निर्यात व्यापार' केवल सामान के निर्यात को संदर्भित करता है। विकल्प B 'अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार' एक व्यापक शब्द है जो सभी अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार गतिविधियों को शामिल करता है। विकल्प D 'बाह्य व्यापार' भी व्यापार के लिए एक सामान्य शब्द है लेकिन विशेष रूप से वर्णित आयात-निर्यात चक्र को संदर्भित नहीं करता है।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is C: 'एंट्रेपोट व्यापार'. This term refers to the practice of importing goods into one country and then exporting them to another without significant transformation. Option A 'निर्यात व्यापार' refers only to exporting goods. Option B 'अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार' is a broader term that includes all international trade activities. Option D 'बाह्य व्यापार' is also a general term for trade but does not specifically refer to the import-export cycle described.

questions.question_english: According to whom "Statistics are numerical statements of facts in any department of enquiry placed in relation to each other" ?

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Thomas Malthus. He defined statistics as numerical statements of facts in any department of inquiry placed in relation to each other. questions.explanation: The correct answer is Thomas Malthus. He defined statistics as numerical statements of facts in any department of inquiry placed in relation to each other. The other options, Yule and Kendall, Bowley, and Webster, may have contributed to the field of statistics but did not provide this specific definition.

questions.question_english:
Loading is usually involved in all such items which are recorded at the invoice price in the Consignment Account.Which of these is not one of
those items?
questions.question_hindi: लोडिंग आमतौर पर उन सभी वस्तुओं में शामिल होती है जो कंसाइनमेंट खाते में चालान मूल्य पर दर्ज की जाती हैं। इनमें से कौन सी वस्तु इनमें से नहीं है?
options_hindi: कंसाइन करने वाले द्वारा लौटाई गई वस्तुएं
questions.explanation_english: In a consignment account, loading refers to the additional costs included in the invoice price of goods. Opening stock, goods sent on consignment, and expenses incurred by the consignor are all items that typically include loading. However, goods returned by the consignee do not include loading costs because they are not part of the initial sale or invoice price; they represent a return of goods rather than a sale. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Goods Returned by the Consignee.
questions.explanation_hindi: कंसाइनमेंट खाते में लोडिंग उन अतिरिक्त लागतों को संदर्भित करती है जो वस्तुओं की चालान कीमत में शामिल होती हैं। ओपनिंग स्टॉक, कंसाइनमेंट पर भेजी गई वस्तुएं, और कंसाइनर द्वारा उठाए गए खर्चे सभी ऐसी वस्तुएं हैं जिनमें आमतौर पर लोडिंग शामिल होती है। हालांकि, कंसाइन करने वाले द्वारा लौटाई गई वस्तुएं लोडिंग लागतों को शामिल नहीं करती हैं क्योंकि ये प्रारंभिक बिक्री या चालान मूल्य का हिस्सा नहीं होती हैं; ये वस्तुओं की वापसी का प्रतिनिधित्व करती हैं न कि बिक्री का। इसलिए सही उत्तर है विकल्प बी: कंसाइन करने वाले द्वारा लौटाई गई वस्तुएं।
questions.explanation: In a consignment account, loading refers to the additional costs included in the invoice price of goods. Opening stock, goods sent on consignment, and expenses incurred by the consignor are all items that typically include loading. However, goods returned by the consignee do not include loading costs because they are not part of the initial sale or invoice price; they represent a return of goods rather than a sale. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Goods Returned by the Consignee.

questions.question_hindi: इनमें से कौन लागत निर्धारण की विधि नहीं है?
questions.explanation_english: Cost determination methods include various approaches to calculate costs. Operational cost, standard cost, and contract cost are all recognized methods. However, 'कायिक लागत निर्धारण' (which translates to 'physical cost determination') is not a standard method used in cost accounting. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: मानक लागत.

questions.explanation: Cost determination methods include various approaches to calculate costs. Operational cost, standard cost, and contract cost are all recognized methods. However, 'कायिक लागत निर्धारण' (which translates to 'physical cost determination') is not a standard method used in cost accounting. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: मानक लागत.

questions.question_english: Which is not a direct or indirect cost?
questions.question_hindi: कौन सी सीधी या अप्रत्यक्ष लागत नहीं है?
questions.explanation_english: Direct costs are those that can be directly attributed to a specific product or service, while indirect costs are not directly linked to a specific item. Oncosts, overhead costs, and down costs are typically considered either direct or indirect costs. However, 'सप्लीमेंटरी लागत' (Supplementary costs) do not fit into these categories as they are not standard classifications in cost accounting. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Supplementary costs.
questions.explanation_hindi: सीधी लागत वे होती हैं जिन्हें किसी विशेष उत्पाद या सेवा से सीधे जोड़ा जा सकता है, जबकि अप्रत्यक्ष लागत सीधे किसी विशेष आइटम से जुड़ी नहीं होती हैं। ओनकॉस्ट्स, ओवरहेड लागत, और डाउन कॉस्ट आमतौर पर सीधी या अप्रत्यक्ष लागतों के रूप में मानी जाती हैं। हालांकि, 'सप्लीमेंटरी लागत' (सप्लीमेंटरी लागत) इन श्रेणियों में नहीं आती हैं क्योंकि ये लागत लेखांकन में मानक वर्गीकरण नहीं हैं। इसलिए सही उत्तर है विकल्प बी: सप्लीमेंटरी लागत।
questions.explanation: Direct costs are those that can be directly attributed to a specific product or service, while indirect costs are not directly linked to a specific item. Oncosts, overhead costs, and down costs are typically considered either direct or indirect costs. However, 'सप्लीमेंटरी लागत' (Supplementary costs) do not fit into these categories as they are not standard classifications in cost accounting. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Supplementary costs.

questions.explanation_english: A company can be classified based on the liability of its members. A limited company restricts the liability of its shareholders to the amount unpaid on their shares, while an unlimited company does not impose such restrictions. In this case, 'असीमित कंपनी' (Unlimited Company) is the correct answer because it is characterized by the fact that the liability of its members is not limited, meaning they can be held personally liable for the company's debts. The other options, such as private and public companies, have limited liability.

questions.question_english:
A company forfeited 400 equity shares of Rs. 10 each issued at a discount of 10 percent for non-payment of two calls of Rs. 2 each. What will be
the amount forfeited by the company?
questions.question_hindi: एक कंपनी ने 400 शेयरों को 10 रुपये प्रत्येक के लिए जब्त किया जो 10 प्रतिशत की छूट पर जारी किए गए थे, दो कॉल के नॉन-पेमेंट के लिए जो 2 रुपये प्रत्येक के थे। कंपनी द्वारा जब्त की गई राशि क्या होगी?
questions.explanation_english: To calculate the amount forfeited by the company, we need to consider the number of shares forfeited and the amount due for non-payment. Each share has a face value of Rs. 10, and the company issued them at a 10% discount, meaning they were issued at Rs. 9 each. The calls that were not paid were Rs. 2 each for two calls, totaling Rs. 4 per share. Therefore, the total amount forfeited is 400 shares multiplied by Rs. 4, which equals Rs. 1,600. Thus, the correct answer is 'Rs. 1,600'.
questions.explanation_hindi: कंपनी द्वारा जब्त की गई राशि की गणना करने के लिए, हमें जब्त किए गए शेयरों की संख्या और नॉन-पेमेंट के लिए देय राशि पर विचार करना होगा। प्रत्येक शेयर का फेस वैल्यू 10 रुपये है, और कंपनी ने इन्हें 10% छूट पर जारी किया, जिसका अर्थ है कि इन्हें 9 रुपये प्रति शेयर पर जारी किया गया। जो कॉल भुगतान नहीं किए गए थे, वे 2 रुपये प्रति शेयर के लिए थे, कुल मिलाकर 4 रुपये प्रति शेयर। इसलिए, कुल जब्त की गई राशि 400 शेयरों को 4 रुपये से गुणा करने पर मिलती है, जो 1,600 रुपये के बराबर है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'रु.1,600' है।
questions.explanation: To calculate the amount forfeited by the company, we need to consider the number of shares forfeited and the amount due for non-payment. Each share has a face value of Rs. 10, and the company issued them at a 10% discount, meaning they were issued at Rs. 9 each. The calls that were not paid were Rs. 2 each for two calls, totaling Rs. 4 per share. Therefore, the total amount forfeited is 400 shares multiplied by Rs. 4, which equals Rs. 1,600. Thus, the correct answer is 'Rs. 1,600'.

questions.question_english:
X sets up a new business on October 1, 1987 and does not close his books on March 31,1988. What will be the period of previous year for the
assessment year 1989-90?
questions.question_hindi: X ने 1 अक्टूबर 1987 को एक नया व्यवसाय स्थापित किया और 31 मार्च 1988 को अपनी किताबें बंद नहीं की। 1989-90 के लिए पिछले वर्ष की अवधि क्या होगी?
questions.explanation_english: The previous year for tax assessment purposes is defined as the financial year preceding the assessment year. In this case, X started the business on October 1, 1987, and did not close the books until March 31, 1988. Therefore, the previous year will be from October 1, 1987, to March 31, 1989, which is a total of 18 months. However, since the assessment year is 1989-90, the previous year is considered to be from October 1, 1987, to March 31, 1989, making it a total of 24 months. Thus, the correct answer is '24 months'.
questions.explanation_hindi: कर आकलन के उद्देश्यों के लिए पिछले वर्ष की अवधि को आकलन वर्ष से पूर्व के वित्तीय वर्ष के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है। इस मामले में, X ने 1 अक्टूबर 1987 को व्यवसाय शुरू किया और 31 मार्च 1988 तक अपनी किताबें बंद नहीं की। इसलिए, पिछले वर्ष की अवधि 1 अक्टूबर 1987 से 31 मार्च 1989 तक होगी, जो कुल 18 महीने है। हालांकि, चूंकि आकलन वर्ष 1989-90 है, पिछले वर्ष की अवधि को 1 अक्टूबर 1987 से 31 मार्च 1989 तक माना जाएगा, जिससे यह कुल 24 महीने हो जाता है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर '24 महीने' है।
questions.explanation: The previous year for tax assessment purposes is defined as the financial year preceding the assessment year. In this case, X started the business on October 1, 1987, and did not close the books until March 31, 1988. Therefore, the previous year will be from October 1, 1987, to March 31, 1989, which is a total of 18 months. However, since the assessment year is 1989-90, the previous year is considered to be from October 1, 1987, to March 31, 1989, making it a total of 24 months. Thus, the correct answer is '24 months'.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Partner's current account' because this account is specifically used to record the transactions between the partners, including their share of profits and losses. questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Partner's current account' because this account is specifically used to record the transactions between the partners, including their share of profits and losses. The profit and loss account shows the overall profitability of the business, while the profit and loss appropriation account details how profits are distributed among partners. The profit and loss adjustment account is used for adjustments, not for direct profit distribution. Therefore, the partner's current account is the most appropriate choice for profit distribution among partners.

questions.question_english: What is the the first factor influencing a buyer's decision?

questions.explanation_english: The first factor influencing a buyer's decision is age. Age can determine a buyer's preferences, needs, and purchasing power. For example, younger buyers may prefer trendy products, while older buyers may prioritize quality and durability. The other options, such as education, family, and occupation, also influence decisions but are not as fundamental as age in shaping initial preferences.
questions.explanation_hindi: खरीदार के निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाला पहला कारक उम्र है। उम्र खरीदार की प्राथमिकताओं, आवश्यकताओं और खरीदने की शक्ति को निर्धारित कर सकती है। उदाहरण के लिए, युवा खरीदार ट्रेंडी उत्पादों को पसंद कर सकते हैं, जबकि वृद्ध खरीदार गुणवत्ता और स्थायित्व को प्राथमिकता दे सकते हैं। अन्य विकल्प, जैसे शिक्षा, परिवार और व्यवसाय, भी निर्णयों को प्रभावित करते हैं, लेकिन प्राथमिक प्राथमिकताओं को आकार देने में उम्र के रूप में मौलिक नहीं हैं।
questions.explanation: The first factor influencing a buyer's decision is age. Age can determine a buyer's preferences, needs, and purchasing power. For example, younger buyers may prefer trendy products, while older buyers may prioritize quality and durability. The other options, such as education, family, and occupation, also influence decisions but are not as fundamental as age in shaping initial preferences.

questions.question_english:
What is a program or policy of a company that aims to eliminate discrimination by providing equal opportunities and thereby improving his /her
profession?
questions.question_hindi: एक कंपनी की वह नीति या कार्यक्रम क्या है जिसका उद्देश्य भेदभाव को समाप्त करना है, समान अवसर प्रदान करके और इस प्रकार उसके पेशे में सुधार करना है?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Decentralisation'. Decentralisation refers to the distribution of authority and responsibility away from a central authority, which can help in providing equal opportunities and reducing discrimination. Affirmative action is a policy aimed at increasing opportunities for historically marginalized groups, but it does not directly relate to the concept of decentralisation. Inclusive growth refers to economic growth that is distributed fairly across society, but it does not specifically address discrimination in professional opportunities. Performance appraisal is a method of evaluating employee performance and does not relate to eliminating discrimination.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर 'विकेंद्रीकरण' है। विकेंद्रीकरण का अर्थ है केंद्रीय प्राधिकरण से अधिकार और जिम्मेदारी का वितरण, जो समान अवसर प्रदान करने और भेदभाव को कम करने में मदद कर सकता है। सकारात्मक कार्रवाई एक नीति है जिसका उद्देश्य ऐतिहासिक रूप से हाशिए पर रहे समूहों के लिए अवसर बढ़ाना है, लेकिन यह सीधे विकेंद्रीकरण के सिद्धांत से संबंधित नहीं है। समावेशी विकास का अर्थ है आर्थिक विकास जो समाज में समान रूप से वितरित होता है, लेकिन यह पेशेवर अवसरों में भेदभाव को विशेष रूप से संबोधित नहीं करता है। प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन एक कर्मचारी के प्रदर्शन का मूल्यांकन करने की विधि है और यह भेदभाव को समाप्त करने से संबंधित नहीं है।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Decentralisation'. Decentralisation refers to the distribution of authority and responsibility away from a central authority, which can help in providing equal opportunities and reducing discrimination. Affirmative action is a policy aimed at increasing opportunities for historically marginalized groups, but it does not directly relate to the concept of decentralisation. Inclusive growth refers to economic growth that is distributed fairly across society, but it does not specifically address discrimination in professional opportunities. Performance appraisal is a method of evaluating employee performance and does not relate to eliminating discrimination.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is '3:2'. Initially, A, B, and C share profits in the ratio of 3:2:1. MBO is a management model that aims to improve organizational performance by clearly defining objectives that are agreed upon by both management and employees. The other options, while notable figures in management, did not introduce this specific concept. Dale Yoder is known for his work in human resource management, Peter F. Drucker is a well-known management consultant but did not specifically introduce MBO in 1954, and Dale S. Beach is known for his contributions to management but not specifically for MBO.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर 'एडिवन बी लॉक' है। उन्होंने 1954 में प्रबंधन द्वारा उद्देश्यों (MBO) की अवधारणा प्रस्तुत की। MBO एक प्रबंधन मॉडल है जो संगठनों के प्रदर्शन को सुधारने के लिए स्पष्ट उद्देश्यों को परिभाषित करने पर केंद्रित है, जिन्हें प्रबंधन और कर्मचारियों दोनों द्वारा सहमति दी जाती है। अन्य विकल्प, जबकि प्रबंधन में उल्लेखनीय व्यक्ति हैं, इस विशेष अवधारणा को पेश नहीं करते हैं। डेल योडर मानव संसाधन प्रबंधन में अपने काम के लिए जाने जाते हैं, पीटर एफ. ड्रकर एक प्रसिद्ध प्रबंधन सलाहकार हैं लेकिन उन्होंने 1954 में विशेष रूप से MBO को पेश नहीं किया, और डेल एस बीच प्रबंधन में अपने योगदान के लिए जाने जाते हैं लेकिन विशेष रूप से MBO के लिए नहीं।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Edwin B. Locke'. He introduced the concept of Management by Objectives (MBO) in 1954. MBO is a management model that aims to improve organizational performance by clearly defining objectives that are agreed upon by both management and employees. The other options, while notable figures in management, did not introduce this specific concept. Dale Yoder is known for his work in human resource management, Peter F. Drucker is a well-known management consultant but did not specifically introduce MBO in 1954, and Dale S. Beach is known for his contributions to management but not specifically for MBO.

questions.question_english:
Reader's Digest magazine offers diaries to its regular subscribers for introducing new subscribers. Which method of conditional premium of
consumer promotion is this an example of?
questions.question_hindi: Reader's Digest पत्रिका अपने नियमित ग्राहकों को नए ग्राहकों को पेश करने के लिए डायरी प्रदान करती है। यह उपभोक्ता प्रचार के शर्तीय प्रीमियम की किस विधि का उदाहरण है?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'उपभोक्ता प्रतियोगिताएँ'. This method involves offering incentives to existing customers for bringing in new customers, which is exactly what Reader's Digest is doing by providing diaries. The other options do not fit this scenario as they involve different promotional strategies. 'कूपन प्रीमियम योजना' involves discounts or coupons, 'रीफिल पैक्स' refers to refillable products, and 'उपयोगकर्ता से उपयोगकर्ता योजना' typically involves peer-to-peer recommendations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर 'उपभोक्ता प्रतियोगिताएँ' है। यह विधि मौजूदा ग्राहकों को नए ग्राहकों को लाने के लिए प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करने से संबंधित है, जो कि Reader's Digest द्वारा डायरी प्रदान करने के माध्यम से किया जा रहा है। अन्य विकल्प इस परिदृश्य में फिट नहीं होते क्योंकि वे विभिन्न प्रचार रणनीतियों को शामिल करते हैं। 'कूपन प्रीमियम योजना' में छूट या कूपन शामिल होते हैं, 'रीफिल पैक्स' फिर से भरने योग्य उत्पादों को संदर्भित करता है, और 'उपयोगकर्ता से उपयोगकर्ता योजना' आमतौर पर सहकर्मी से सहकर्मी सिफारिशों को शामिल करती है।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'उपभोक्ता प्रतियोगिताएँ'. This method involves offering incentives to existing customers for bringing in new customers, which is exactly what Reader's Digest is doing by providing diaries. The other options do not fit this scenario as they involve different promotional strategies. 'कूपन प्रीमियम योजना' involves discounts or coupons, 'रीफिल पैक्स' refers to refillable products, and 'उपयोगकर्ता से उपयोगकर्ता योजना' typically involves peer-to-peer recommendations.

questions.question_english: Preeti is a person who is usually of unsound mind, but occasionally of sound mind. Can she make a contract?
questions.question_hindi: प्रीति एक व्यक्ति है जो आमतौर पर अस्वस्थ मानसिकता की होती है, लेकिन कभी-कभी स्वस्थ मानसिकता की होती है। क्या वह एक अनुबंध कर सकती है?
options_english: No, she cannot make a contract
She can always make a contract
She can make a contract when she is sound mind
options_hindi: नहीं, वह अनुबंध नहीं कर सकती
वह हमेशा अनुबंध कर सकती है
वह तब अनुबंध कर सकती है जब वह स्वस्थ मानसिकता में हो
क्या वह अनुबंध कर सकती है?
questions.explanation_english: In contract law, a person must have the capacity to contract, which means they must be of sound mind. Preeti is usually of unsound mind but can be of sound mind occasionally. Therefore, she can make a contract when she is of sound mind. The other options are incorrect because: Option A is wrong as she can contract when of sound mind; Option B is incorrect as she cannot always contract; Option D is a question and not an answer.

questions.explanation: In contract law, a person must have the capacity to contract, which means they must be of sound mind. Preeti is usually of unsound mind but can be of sound mind occasionally. Therefore, she can make a contract when she is of sound mind. The other options are incorrect because: Option A is wrong as she can contract when of sound mind; Option B is incorrect as she cannot always contract; Option D is a question and not an answer.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option A: 'Coupon rate debenture has fixed rate of interest'. This statement is false because while coupon rate debentures do have a fixed interest rate, the term 'fixed rate of interest' can be misleading in the context of market fluctuations and the nature of the coupon payments. The other options are true: bearer debentures can indeed be transferred, mortgaged debentures are secured, and companies can issue debentures for non-cash considerations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A है: 'कूपन दर डिबेंचर की निश्चित ब्याज दर होती है'। यह कथन गलत है क्योंकि जबकि कूपन दर डिबेंचर की एक निश्चित ब्याज दर होती है, 'निश्चित ब्याज दर' का अर्थ बाजार में उतार-चढ़ाव और कूपन भुगतान की प्रकृति के संदर्भ में भ्रामक हो सकता है। अन्य विकल्प सही हैं: बियरर डिबेंचर को वास्तव में हस्तांतरित किया जा सकता है, बंधक डिबेंचर सुरक्षित होते हैं, और कंपनियां गैर-नकद विचार के लिए डिबेंचर जारी कर सकती हैं।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option A: 'Coupon rate debenture has fixed rate of interest'. This statement is false because while coupon rate debentures do have a fixed interest rate, the term 'fixed rate of interest' can be misleading in the context of market fluctuations and the nature of the coupon payments. The other options are true: bearer debentures can indeed be transferred, mortgaged debentures are secured, and companies can issue debentures for non-cash considerations.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option C: 'वाणिज्य मंत्रालय'. The Ministry of Commerce is responsible for formulating and announcing the foreign trade policy in India. questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option C: 'वाणिज्य मंत्रालय'. The Ministry of Commerce is responsible for formulating and announcing the foreign trade policy in India. The other options, while related to finance and trade, do not have the authority to declare trade policy. The Reserve Bank of India manages monetary policy, the Indian Foreign Exchange Dealers Association deals with forex transactions, and the Ministry of Finance oversees fiscal policy.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option C: 'Government of India'. The Government of India, through the Reserve Bank of India, sets the interest rates for savings accounts.
